document.abstract: The TSS* processor represents a basic device for generating spatial three-dimensional (3-D) sound in theaters that already have installed one of the currently available multichannel stereo processors interfaced with digital readers and decoders for optical digital track. This article describes a prototype of a TSS processor, its basic functional blocks, its physical structure, and its technical specifications. The associated software for soundtrack editing is most important for the processor's overall performances, including the complete TSS system in a theater. Its general outline is also described.
